plugins.name: session-successor
plugins.description: When a session runs low on context it writes a handoff and starts its successor; the companion JetBrains plugin, Session Successor on JetBrains Marketplace (https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/35944-session-successor), opens it in a new terminal tab.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A compact status line: model, project, git branch, colour-coded context left and an hourly phrase. Pure bash. After installing, run /statusline:setup once to switch it on.
